# Identity part 2a (definers, membership guard, login service): isolation review, round 2

Range `5539ab7..00abeb7` on `identity`. Reviewer: isolation-reviewer (opus), 2026-11-14. **Verdict: APPROVED** (0 blocking, 6 follow-up). `tests/identity tests/audit tests/schema`: 270 passed; rolled-back probes as `shifde_app` on a scratch database (dropped).

Passed: `test_function_schema.py` allowlist keyed by full signature, overloads still refused (B-610), signature keys need every lockdown rule, stale entries fail, identity entries pinned to owner `shifde_owner` and `search_path = pg_catalog, pg_temp`; `login_lockouts` fits `PRINCIPAL_TABLES` (per-person, no `tenant_id`, forced RLS, `own_row` USING + WITH CHECK, no DELETE); `deliberate_changes.yaml` entry correct; the two changed `audit/test_cross_client.py` tests are not loosened (old setup was the leak, now refused and pinned); review 1 item 1 closed (A refused on INSERT and ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING by `insert_by_platform_admin`; only `status`, `row_version` updatable); invites refused with the admin flag but no principal and from any client context, redemption writes only the named person's credential; `resolve_session` never admin on a client-pinned session, nothing without an active membership there; `shifde_my_membership_tenants()` only the caller's own; lockouts not readable/writable across people; generic errors.

1. FOLLOW-UP tenancy: `identity_0002_definers.py:79-91` `shifde_revoke_user_sessions`: from A, suspending a person also in B revokes their unpinned sessions (used for B too), and the platform admin's unpinned session when the admin holds a membership in A: a client can repeatedly log a shared member, or the admin, out. Revoke only sessions pinned to the current client; refuse a platform-admin target; cross-client test with `world.both`.
2. 5. FOLLOW-UP identity 2b / audit: `audit/service.py:64-75`: `PRE_TENANT_ACTIONS` now include login succeeded, logout, setup-token redeemed: any no-context code can write a global row with any actor (hostile-only). Check `actor_id = current_principal_id()` for those.
